top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Have an alternate power supply for its alarm system.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Meet requirements for the use of electrical equipment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.
Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
